operators.name: reduce_mean_dim1
semantics: Computes mean over dimension 1 (channel) with keepdim=True as in torch.mean(x, dim=1, keepdim=True)
Reduction follows exact reference semantics including summation order (sequential accumulation over C) as torch.mean would
Input may be non-contiguous; kernel handles arbitrary strides
Output tensor stride pattern matches reference step_001: [H*W, H*W, W, 1] for standard contiguous input, but general stride support guaranteed

operators.name: mul_scalar

Element-wise multiplication, output shape identical to input
Output stride pattern matches reference step_002: [H*W, H*W, W, 1] for standard contiguous input

Element-wise multiplication by Python scalar out_channels=4
